argv:
mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals reports && cat > .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.yaml <<'EOF'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arithmetic_smoke
  name: Arithmetic smoke
target:
  servers:
    - name: Arithmetic
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_add_two_three
    title: Add 2 and 3 and return 5
    steps:
      - id: ask
        kind: prompt
        prompt: Use the add tool to add 2 and 3. Report the returned sum.
      - id: args
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledWith
          toolName: add
          args:
            args: {a: 2, b: 3}
            argumentMatching: exact
      - id: result
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolResultContains
          toolName: add
          needle: '5'
      - id: errors
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: noToolErrors
EOF
npx mcpjam cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.yaml --project project_fixture --format json > reports/validation.json && cat reports/validation.json && npx mcpjam cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.yaml --project project_fixture --server server_fixture --wait --format json > reports/run.json 2>reports/run.stderr
